assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a standalone 16:9 game menu BACKGROUND ASSET, no UI, no lettering, no logos, no people, no mannequin. A richly detailed modern nightclub dance stage: mirrored disco ball in the upper LEFT corner, steel lighting truss ceiling, magenta cyan violet and a few warm amber spotlights, tall black speaker stacks at the left wall, graffiti walls, polished reflective dance floor. Camera frontal, wide shot. The left 40% must contain the stage with empty space for an animated 3D dancer centered around x=20%, and an empty upper-left branding region. Right 60% should be dark navy atmospheric nightclub extending the same floor, low contrast so an actual HTML panel can overlay it. Floor horizon around 62% height. Saturated neon lighting, deep navy shadows, beautiful cyan pink and amber reflections, polished 3D game art, realistic materials. This is a background layer only, no graphical controls, no cards, no border, no words. Save the generated asset for use in the current You Dance project.
